candidates.A: published-grid production proxy (benchmark only; mixes model and market)
candidates.C: independent research model team_form_poisson_v1 (value shortlist; uses no odds)
candidates.C2: candidate: C with a draw and low-score correction (rho, delta) fitted walk-forward on C's own earlier forecasts and their scores, pooled across leagues (research_low_score.py; uses no odds)
candidates.C3: candidate: C with historical Understat match xG in the team form, from matches before the fold origin only (understat_history.py; five big leagues, C elsewhere; uses no odds)
candidates.C5: candidate: C with its home/away split sharpened by a calibration slope fitted walk-forward on C's own earlier forecasts of decided matches, draw held, pooled across leagues (research_sharpen.py; uses no odds)
candidates.C6: candidate: C2's draw and low-score corrected grid with its home/away split sharpened by a slope fitted walk-forward on C2's own earlier forecasts of decided matches, C2's draw held, pooled across leagues (research_low_score_sharpen.py; uses no odds)
candidates.D: cagey tier: M corrected toward narrow margins (production correction model)
candidates.M: market reference: margin-free fit to the period bookmaker (Pinnacle, Bet365 on the holdout)

calibration_tolerance.name: slopes-0.90-1.10-bands-30-5pp-bonferroni-v2

replaces.name: slopes-0.90-1.10-bands-30-5pp-v1
replaces.reason: Replaced before any holdout scoring: v1 failed a band on any gap above 5 points, however few matches, so it failed even the market reference M on noise.
replaces.rule: Same slopes; a band failed whenever it was more than 5 percentage points from its observed rate (at least 30 matches), with no allowance for sample size.

calibration_tolerance.rule: Logistic calibration slope (logit P(outcome) = a + b logit(p), fitted per outcome) of the home and of the away probability both between 0.90 and 1.10 inclusive, and no failing outcome probability band (home, draw and away, tenths of probability, at least 30 matches). A band fails only if it is more than 5 percentage points from its observed rate AND the gap is statistically clear: |gap| / sqrt(p(1-p)/n) above the two-sided normal quantile for 0.05 divided by the number of bands checked (Bonferroni; about 3.0 for 20 bands), p = the band's mean forecast.

calibration_tolerance_rules.description: Further named calibration rules a declaration may name instead of calibration_tolerance (v2, which stays the rule locked runs report first and the rule of C6's holdout record). Each applies only to candidates not yet scored on a holdout.

cagey-events-v1.caveats: Events of one fixture in family (b) are nested and come from one side, so they are not independent; the band test treats each event as one observation, as v3 does, which makes it somewhat stricter for D and M alike. Bookmaker AH margins differ by league (Bet365 2025/26 validation: Eredivisie and Super Lig about 5.4%, others about 4.1%); one average per bookmaker is used, as decided.
cagey-events-v1.decided_note: Decided by Paul on 12 Nov 2026 (the event families, v3's logic, pass = both families); the line set, synthetic prices and side choice were settled with him on 13 Nov 2026. All before any scoring of D or M on the holdout (evaluation/holdout_ledger.json holds only C6). Applies only to the cagey tier (D) against the plain market fit (M).
cagey-events-v1.lines_source: asian_handicap.LINES: every quarter line from -3.00 to +3.00, the AH lines the live feed can quote. Rule no-loss-market-reference-v5 (production) bets any quoted AH line in its odds window; price_edge_cagey_shortlist.TIER_LINES (+1.00 to +2.25) belongs to the older v28 tier rule and is not used.
cagey-events-v1.name: cagey-events-v1
cagey-events-v1.rule: Two event families, each pooled across its lines; a candidate passes when both pass. (a) narrow: P(|margin| <= 1), one event per fixture. (b) no_loss: P(no loss) on the AH lines the cagey tier can bet. Every line in `lines`, both sides, is priced: the main line at the period bookmaker's real quote (Pinnacle to 15 Jan 2026, Bet365 after), every other line at M's fair odds divided by 1 + that bookmaker's average AH margin (synthetic_ah_margin). A line is bettable when its price is in the odds window. Only one side per fixture is bet: the side whose best bettable line has the higher expected return under D (cost 0; home on an exact tie). The chosen side's bettable lines reduce to one event per family floor(line) in quarter units, the event 'side margin >= -floor(line)' (lines k to k + 0.75 share it: -3 win by 3+, -2 win by 2+, -1 win by 1+, 0 win or draw, +1 lose by at most 1, +2 lose by at most 2, +3 lose by at most 3). D and M are scored on the same events. Per family, calibration rule v3's logic on the binary event: the candidate's logistic calibration slope (logit P(y) = a + b logit(p)) passes if it is between 0.90 and 1.10 inclusive OR its distance from 1.0 is smaller than M's slope on the same events; no failing band (tenths of probability, at least 30 events), a band failing only if more than 5 percentage points from its observed rate AND |gap| / sqrt(p(1-p)/n) is above the two-sided normal quantile for 0.05 divided by the number of the family's bands checked (Bonferroni). M checked against itself passes a slope only inside 0.90-1.10.

slopes-0.90-1.10-or-closer-than-baseline.decided_note: Decided on 12 Nov 2026, before any European holdout scoring (evaluation/european_holdout_ledger.json has no entry). Applies only to candidates not yet scored on a holdout; v2 stays for C6's record.
slopes-0.90-1.10-or-closer-than-baseline.name: slopes-0.90-1.10-or-closer-than-baseline-bands-30-5pp-bonferroni-v3
slopes-0.90-1.10-or-closer-than-baseline.rule: Relative slopes. Each of the candidate's home and away logistic calibration slopes (logit P(outcome) = a + b logit(p), fitted per outcome) passes if it is between 0.90 and 1.10 inclusive, OR its distance from 1.0 is smaller than the declared baseline's slope for the same outcome on the same fixtures (both slopes fitted on the fixtures both forecast). Bands exactly as v2: no outcome probability band (home, draw and away, tenths of probability, at least 30 matches) more than 5 percentage points from its observed rate AND statistically clear (|gap| / sqrt(p(1-p)/n) above the two-sided normal quantile for 0.05 divided by the number of bands checked; Bonferroni), p = the band's mean forecast.

holdout_choice.rule: The most recent block no benchmark, written model audit or live report scored, counted as for the domestic holdout: automated in-run pipeline reports (decay tuning, goal-market validation) are not counted, as they also covered the domestic holdout window.

periods.retrospective: UEL from 21 Jan 2025 (scored by the 22 Oct 2026 Europa audits and the pipeline's goal-market validation, live-graded from 22 Oct 2026) and UCL from 13 Oct 2026 (live-graded). Diagnostics only, never release evidence.
periods.validation: 1 Jul 2024 - 20 Jan 2025 (unchanged): UEL, and UCL 2024/25 to 20 Jan. UEL 2024/25 was the Europa research audit's development period: already inspected.
periods.warm_up: Training only, never scored: each competition's results until its 14-day fold has at least 250 earlier matches of that competition (the pipeline's own UCL/UEL walk-forward warm-up). UCL: 2015/16-2016/17 (exactly 250, the two single-source seasons); development from the 4 Sep 2017 fold. UEL: 2020/21 and 2021/22 to 24 Oct 2021; development from the 25 Oct 2021 fold. Checked against the data by evaluation_harness.check_development_start.

periods.warm_up: 2021/22 is training history only; scoring starts 1 Aug 2022.

config.release_rule: A candidate is scored on the holdout once, against a written declaration. It must beat its baseline with the 95% week-resampled interval clear of zero, and must beat the market reference by more than the measured Bet365-Pinnacle gap to count as beating the market. Before release it must pass a parity test (harness and live pipeline give identical probabilities) and a replay over the saved live forecasts. There is no forward waiting for backtestable changes. Changes reach production only through a reviewed PR, with monitoring and a rollback trigger afterwards.

declaration.declared_by: Paul (decision, 12 Nov 2026), written by Claude Code
declaration.holdout: Domestic holdout: Eredivisie, Primeira Liga and Super Lig, 16 Jan - 10 Oct 2026 (646 matches, 25 weeks), Bet365 pre-match prices with the margin removed; evaluation_harness.py --declaration, recorded in evaluation/holdout_ledger.json
declaration.notes: Scored once. No rerun, no change to the setup after it, and no other candidate scored on the holdout. Production code is unchanged either way.
declaration.outcome_rule: Passed: Phase 3 is done and the cagey tier stays as it is. Failed: report which family failed and how; no logic changes; a fix would be a separate decision.
declaration.pass_rule: D passes only if the sample minimum is met (300 fixtures and 6 weeks, counted on the holdout fixtures where D and M are both scored on AH lines) and D's holdout forecasts pass calibration rule cagey-events-v1 against M on the same events: both event families, (a) P(|margin| <= 1) and (b) P(no loss) on the AH lines the cagey tier can bet (-3.00 to +3.00, odds window (1.15, 2.00], one side per fixture by D's expected return, one event per floor(line) family), each with its slope in 0.90-1.10 or closer to 1 than M's, and no band of at least 30 events more than 5 points off AND Bonferroni-clear (holdout_verdict.passes_holdout_gate). M minus D log loss on AH all lines and on the draw-sensitive lines (-0.5, 0, +0.5), whole weeks resampled with 95% intervals, is reported as context and does not decide.
declaration.question: Phase 3: is the cagey tier (D: the market fit plus the narrow-margin correction) a well-calibrated market view of the events it bets, at least as well calibrated as the plain market fit (M)? Not whether it beats M on log loss: on development, validation and the retrospective the AH all-lines difference is +0.0003 to +0.0004, far below the holdout's resolution.
declaration.setup: Calibration rule cagey-events-v1 decided by Paul on 12 Nov 2026; its line set, synthetic prices (M's fair odds plus the bookmaker's average AH margin, frozen in the config) and side choice settled with him on 13 Nov 2026. All before any scoring of D or M on the holdout (the ledger holds only C6). D and M as in production and PR #166 (correction model cagey-correction-through-2425-v1); nothing tuned on the holdout.

holdout_verdict.next_steps: Calibration-deciding test: passing confirms the candidate against its baseline on the declared rule; any production change still needs a reviewed PR.

notes: Headline means use the common cohort: fixtures where C, C2, C3, C5, C6, M, D and A are all available (C3 and C5 exist wherever C does, C6 wherever C2 does).
Positive mean_gain means the first-named candidate has the lower log loss than the second.
Intervals resample whole calendar weeks across all leagues.
The cagey correction was trained on seasons through 2024/25; D is in-sample in development.
Retrospective results were already scored elsewhere; they are diagnostics, never release evidence.
Historical prices are pre-match snapshots without timestamps; returns are not claimed.
No automatic promotion: every production change goes through a reviewed PR.
